GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-08-14T09:24:53Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: ConcatMap caches value from upstream
Description: This issue was reproduces on RX-Java v2.2.6 and v3.0.0-RC1

I have this piece of code:

```java
@Test
public void concatMapCachedValueTest() throws InterruptedException {
  Flowable
    .interval(0, 1000, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, Schedulers.io())
    .onBackpressureDrop()
    .concatMap(aLong -> Flowable.just(aLong)
        .delay(3500, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, Schedulers.io())
    )
    .subscribe(aLong -> System.out.println(aLong));
    Thread.sleep(18000);
}
```

When I run it it prints:
0
1
4
5
11

I would expect it to print:
0
4
8
12
16

But it seems that concatMap is caching another value from the upstream while starting processing the Flowable returned by current value.
This happens even if you set the prefetch parameter of concatMap to 1, setting it to 0 is illegal.
